name: Seki (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Seki city emblem in white: an outlined ring with four small points enclosing a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Seki, a city in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 17 July 1963.

features.role: Seki city emblem — an outlined ring with four small points enclosing a ring
